final: WITH j AS (SELECT pa.player_id AS pid, p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS c FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), h AS (SELECT bats, SUM(c) AS total FROM j GROUP BY bats), o AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS overall FROM h), s AS (SELECT h.bats, h.total, h.total * 1.0 / o.overall AS share FROM h JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.bats, s.total, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
